import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe")
venv = repo / ".venv"
if not (venv / "bin" / "python").exists():
    subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "venv", str(venv)], cwd=repo, check=True)

pip = str(venv / "bin" / "pip")
subprocess.run([pip, "install", "-r", "requirements-dev.txt"], cwd=repo, check=True)
print("jobpipe environment ready")
